invoice.description: Professional emergency preparedness training workshop focusing on scenario-based security drills, evacuation strategies, and coordinated response procedures with municipal law enforcement for protection of personal and corporate holdings in the Charleston area. Includes on-site assessment, customized training modules, and post-event security audit report. All services provided by certified security professionals with 15+ years of experience in corporate protection and crisis management. Training conducted at client's primary facility with full equipment and support staff provided by Sentinel Security Consulting LLC. Includes 30-day follow-up consultation and access to our emergency response hotline for 12 months post-training. All materials and documentation provided in both physical and digital formats for client records and compliance purposes. This invoice covers the complete training package as discussed and agreed upon during our initial consultation on June 15, 2024. Please reference invoice number EPW-2024-109 for all payment and correspondence matters. For questions regarding this invoice or the services provided, please contact our billing department at billing@sentinelsecurity.com or call (703) 555-9942 during business hours (8:00 AM - 6:00 PM EST, Monday through Friday). We appreciate your business and look forward to continuing our professional relationship. This document serves as both an invoice and a service agreement acknowledgment.
